# Load packages

```{r}
library(sf)
library(gdalUtils)
library(here)
library(raster)
library(fasterize)
library(exactextractr)

t_crs<-"+proj=aea +lat_1=-9 +lat_2=-26 +lat_0=-17 +lon_0=180 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
```

# Load Allen Coral Atlas data from prep

```{r}
reef<-st_read(here("projected_data/Allen_Coral_Atlas/coral_algae_proj.shp"))

reef<-st_transform(reef, t_crs)
```


# Load diffusion model results

```{r}
diff<-raster(here("output_data/diffusion_results/04_wavesed_Feb2022.tiff"))

diff<-projectRaster(diff,  crs = t_crs)
```


# Calculate nutrients per reef pixel/polygon

## Raster

Create reef raster

```{r}
reef_ras<-fasterize(reef, diff)
```

Multiply diffusion by reef raster to get nutrients in each reef pixel

```{r}
reef_diff<-reef_ras*diff
```

```{r}
writeRaster(reef_diff, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Nutrients_at_reefs.tif"))
```


## Polygon

This takes forever so make sure we want it before doing it.... easier as a raster

```{r}
reef_diff_mean<-reef %>% 
  mutate(N = exact_extract(diff, ., 'mean'))

st_write(reef_diff_mean, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Nutrients_at_reefs_mean.shp"))

test<-reef_diff_mean %>% 
  filter(!is.nan(N) == T)

reef_diff_sum<-reef %>% 
  mutate(N = exact_extract(diff, ., 'sum'))

st_write(reef_diff_sum, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Nutrients_at_reefs_sum.shp"))

test2<-reef_diff_sum %>% 
  filter(!is.nan(N) == T,
         N>0)
```
